purpose: Criterion 4 source/hunk audit for the eight unlisted existing touching rows. No register disposition, project file, test, probe or lifecycle action performed.
criterion 4: Another batch or candidate row listed by --touching is left as it is and named in README; the comparison below does not enlarge WO-219.

rows.currentReopenWhen: a planning pass confirms no receipt subject depends on the path
rows.sourceAsk: Remove the one-time WO-043 migration only after a planning pass confirms that no receipt subject depends on it.
rows.changedHunks: plan-dependency-migration.mjs:61 now passes historical ids from the committed original and current root into the existing before/after dependency parsers. plan-continuation.mjs:534 adds story-writeback relocation composition.
rows.leaveUnchangedBecause: Both changes preserve the migration route. Neither establishes that historical receipt subjects no longer depend on it; no removal or receipt migration is proposed. Retain deferred under the existing proof condition.
rows.claimBoundary: Do not reuse the old WO-167 rationale as a claim that this order leaves migration code untouched: this order changes its parser context, while preserving the route.

rows.currentReopenWhen: a task outside the five crosses 1.5 times its median in a phase a pass records as lost to it, or a pass needs a task's reading the table omits
rows.sourceAsk: Reconsider the five-slowest gate-task limit when an omitted task crosses 1.5 times its median in a recorded lost phase, or a pass needs an omitted reading.
rows.changedHunks: planning-conditions.mjs:190 requires three earlier fresh samples; :529 filters absent core sources in instances before probing. The sort and .slice(0,5) at :176–178 remain.
rows.leaveUnchangedBecause: The changed behavior is minimum sample support and instance applicability, not task selection. No lost phase or needed omitted task reading is established by these hunks. Retain deferred with the exact existing condition.
rows.claimBoundary: An intentionally failing mutation control is not evidence of a real gate-task regression or a phase lost to it.

rows.currentReopenWhen: WO-219's first verification fails on more than a third of its rows, or its implementation passes 20 hours
rows.sourceAsk: Reconsider WO-219 size if its first verification fails on more than a third of rows or implementation exceeds 20 hours.
rows.changedHunks: The touching hit is the WO-219 identity. This change executes the declared 50-row batch and records its bounded controls; it does not split or resize the order.
rows.leaveUnchangedBecause: At the touching-report cutoff there is no Verification event in the canonical WO-219 segment, and elapsed time since activation is about 2 h 24 m. Neither stated trigger is established. Retain deferred.
rows.claimBoundary: The elapsed figure is a canonical activation-to-report span, not a claim about all unobserved work. Expected negative mutation exits are not this order’s first verification verdict.

rows.currentReopenWhen: collectSources reaches three seconds cold or warm on the operator's host (WO-164-D009, D014), a cold release list exceeds ten seconds (D004), status --all --json output exceeds 32 MB (D003), or work-orders index exceeds ten seconds.
rows.sourceAsk: Reopen measured growth costs on the current register thresholds: collectSources 3 s cold/warm, cold release list 10 s, status JSON 32 MB, or work-orders index 10 s; the source candidate also identifies console/index cost.
rows.changedHunks: work-orders.mjs passes historical ids through header/index readers and adds checkPreflightSuites, which spawns the checkout’s declaration reader once when Preflight tokens exist. The release-record/index collection path is retained.
rows.leaveUnchangedBecause: The new declaration check can add index work, so the old unused-import-only rationale is not the present rationale. The diff supplies no measured crossing of any recorded threshold and makes no performance-settlement claim. Retain deferred pending the named measurement.
rows.claimBoundary: No latency was measured by this audit. Aggregate fixture duration cannot substitute for timing the named operation; no claim is made that the added check is free.

rows.currentReopenWhen: an observed deadline loss, or two successive episodes of one kind above 80% of their respective timeout; review each entropy pass
rows.sourceAsk: Keep the accepted headroom NoOp until a deadline loss or two successive episodes of one kind above 80% of their timeouts; review each entropy pass.
rows.changedHunks: The textual hit is planning-conditions.mjs. Its changes concern fresh gate-task sample count and absent instance sources; worker timeout constants, runner deadline behavior and entropy headroom policy are not changed.
rows.leaveUnchangedBecause: These hunks neither adjust the entropy timeout nor supply a qualifying review/refutation episode observation. Retain the existing deferred headroom NoOp and its cadence/threshold.
rows.claimBoundary: This review did not inventory later entropy episodes and does not assert global absence of deadline losses; the present code change supplies no such trigger.

rows.currentReopenWhen: The operator returns to the WO-217 packet, or a probe records a detached descendant surviving a bounded command after the guard
rows.sourceAsk: Establish ownership through unobserved intermediate exits, including ignored-wrapper bare commands. Current disposition waits for the WO-217 packet or a recorded detached survivor after the guard.
rows.changedHunks: test-runner.mjs changes machinery-source declarations and --list --review inventory selection. The changed-file report contains no host-resources.mjs or host-guard.mjs change, and no inheritable ownership/event-source mechanism.
rows.leaveUnchangedBecause: Test selection does not recover the missing ancestry edge or activate the deferred WO-217 packet. No new detached-survivor observation is supplied by this diff. Preserve deferred and the documented incomplete guarantee.
rows.claimBoundary: Do not infer complete descendant containment from shell-claim pruning, task-notification classification or passing ordinary-child controls.

hunkComparison.method: Read-only git diff --no-ext-diff --unified=3 against the report baseline after cwd/Git-root verification.
